title: 10 Real-World Airline & Hub Schedules! VA Systems Summer 2026 | MSFS 2020
description:
Ready to pack your virtual skies and departure boards with authentic commercial airline traffic in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? VA Systems just rolled out 10 brand-new Summer 2026 schedule releases across the Marketplace—bringing a balanced split of five international airport hub traffic overhauls and five real-world airline fleet schedules spanning North America, Europe, South America, Asia, and Africa.

In this marketplace breakdown, we skip the storefront clutter and organize these arrivals into clear categories—highlighting key aircraft compatibility requirements and prerequisite warnings so you can plan your next flight without surprises:

🛫 INTERNATIONAL HUB TRAFFIC OVERHAULS (VA SYSTEMS)
Inject realistic Summer 2026 commercial arrivals, departures, multi-airline liveries, and authentic gate rotations into major global hubs:
• Tunis–Carthage International Airport (DTTA)
• Warsaw Chopin International Airport (EPWA)
• Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (KPHX)
• Simón Bolívar International Airport, Caracas (SVMI)
• Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai (VABB)
(⚠️ Prerequisite: While liveries and routes are included, you must own the respective compatible aircraft models in MSFS 2020—as not all scheduled airliners are default aircraft).

🌐 GLOBAL AIRLINE FLEET SCHEDULES (VA SYSTEMS)
Eliminate empty flight logs and fly verified Summer 2026 regional and long-haul rotations with dedicated airline route packages and liveries:
• Bamboo Airways (BAV)
• Envoy Air / American Eagle (ENY)
• Garuda Indonesia (GIA)
• Iraqi Airways (IAW)
• ITA Airways (ITY)
(⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires owning the underlying compatible aircraft models before you can apply the included liveries and fly the assigned rotations).

Whether you are filling the terminals at Phoenix Sky Harbor and Warsaw Chopin with realistic summer traffic or flying authentic regional and long-haul rotations for ITA Airways and Envoy Air, these schedule packs add serious commercial immersion to Flight Simulator 2020.

Which of these airline fleet packs or international hub schedules are you adding to your MSFS 2020 installation first? Drop your pick in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2020 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
